text.tspan: retico AbstractConsumingModule — fan-in of all IU streams into one
JSON protocol whose envelope preserves ADD / REVOKE / COMMIT over the wire.
• LLM — recommended cloud (OpenAI / Gemini) for demo latency
(local HF model is the zero-key fallback)
• Polly TTS — only on the Polly viseme path (see viseme diagram)
• Deepgram / Google ASR — optional swap for Whisper (local, no key)
Everything else runs local / CPU / no key.
